GTA 6 characters

Rockstar has named two playable leads and a supporting cast so far. Profiles below are written from Rockstar's official character bios, published with Trailer 2 on 6 May 2025. Expect much more once the game is out.

Leads

Image: Rockstar Games
Playable lead

Jason Duval

Ex-Army, now doing jobs for drug runners down in the Keys.

Image: Rockstar Games
Playable lead

Lucia Caminos

Just out of Leonida Penitentiary and determined not to go back.

Jason's circle

Image: Rockstar Games
Jason's friend

Cal Hampton

Stays home, listens in on the Coast Guard, trusts nobody.

Image: Rockstar Games
Old-school smuggler

Brian Heder

Runs a boat yard in the Keys and gives Jason a roof, for a price.

Image: Rockstar Games
Brian's wife

Lori Heder

Co-runs the boat yard. Famous locally for her sangria.

Only Raw Records

Image: Rockstar Games
Vice City businessman

Boobie Ike

Turned street money into real estate, a strip club and a studio.

Image: Rockstar Games
Music executive

Dre'Quan Priest

Former street dealer chasing a name in Vice City's music scene.

Image: Rockstar Games
Rap duo (Bae-Luxe and Roxy)

Real Dimez

School friends with a social following, hunting a second hit.

Heists

Image: Rockstar Games
Bank robber

Raul Bautista

Veteran robber who recruits people for big, risky scores.
